settings.text:
A better way to shop for fresh food from local farmers. Simple, flexible, and delivered weekly.

Getting fresh organic food direct from local farmers is easier than you may think. We’ve designed our system to make it simple, flexible, and waste free so you can enjoy the best food without the supermarket run.

settings.title: Enter Postcode
settings.text: Check when we deliver to your area and when orders close here.

settings.title: Choose your food
settings.text: Browse our store and pick what you want from our huge range.

settings.title: Farmers harvest
settings.text: Once orders close, our farmers harvest your food fresh. Zero waste.

settings.title: We pack & deliver
settings.text: We carefully pack everything using recycled boxes and deliver to your door.

settings.title: eat Happy Eat Fresh
settings.text: Enjoy fresh, nutrient dense food grown with care for people, animals and the planet.

settings.decription: Pick what you want and select a pick up location or home delivery.
Your produce and groceries are lovingly collected and packed in recycled styrofoam or cardboard boxes with minimal plastic. We only order what we need so there's no waste.
Get your fresh food delivered to your door for just $12.50 or, if you're in Brisbane, choose to collect for free from one of our 30+ pick-up locations.
Feel great about supporting local farmers and makers whilst feeding your family the best quality, pesticide free food.

settings.title: We only sell the best
settings.text:
Everything on our site is spray-free or Certified Organic. We prioritise choosing local but we'll also source from further afield when needed to ensure you have a wide variety of good food to choose from, though we will only ever stock Australian grown produce.


We are continually adding new products to our range of healthy groceries. We love to support local, artisan food makers who are passionate about health and the environment like we are.

We are a female-led, heart-led business.

settings.title: Our mission
settings.text:
We're on a mission to get more families to switch to organic food. Health is our top priority and we want to see our customers and their families thrive. If we want to show up as the best version of ourselves in this world, we have to nourish our bodies with the best quality, nutrient-dense food.


This in turn means we can support new and existing farms where they are regenerating the soil. Soil is LIFE and is ESSENTIAL to the health of our planet. Conventional farming is destroying our soil - we believe regenerative farming is the way forward and we want to do everything we can to help more farmers bring life back to our lands.

settings.title: Other things you might like to know
We're a small team based in Brisbane
settings.text: Our team is comprised of passionate foodies. We're super friendly and aim to provide the most amazing level of customer service possible! We love what we do and are on a mission to create a healthier world and help regenerate our soil for future generations.

settings.title: We love SMS
settings.text:
Our team all work from their own homes so we are best reached via email or SMS: 0480 079 218.


We use SMS to remind our customers to order before their order deadline (if you've ordered in the last month) and when your order is ready to collect or being delivered. We may also check in to see if you meant to order but forgot and to communicate any changes to your order ie. if something is unexpectedly unavailable. You can opt out of SMS communications at any time.

settings.title: Our Facebook Group is awesome
settings.text: Hang out with us on Facebook in our Farmacy Family Facebook Group. We post in here every week about new products, events and recipes. We also ask what new products you want us to stock for you and often do special orders just for customers in the group. We encourage you to share your own meal creations too.

settings.heading: Food You Can Feel Good About

settings.text:
Our friendly food system is simple, flexible, and designed to make eating well easy.

Choose exactly what you want, order when it suits you, and enjoy fresh food harvested each week by farmers who truly care about how it’s grown.

Leave your boxes out with your next order and we’ll reuse them as part of our circular system.

As a small Brisbane family business, we genuinely care about your health, the food on your table, and making the whole experience feel easy, friendly and joyful.
Hundreds of families across South East Queensland already get their fresh food this way every week. Browse the store, choose what you want, and see just how easy good food can be.
